baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction `كانوا لا يرجون حسابا` combines past temporal predication, an imperfect under negation, expectant رجاء, and حساب as reckoning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal predication stabilizes a repeated condition, expectant hope supplies a forward horizon, and reckoning supplies count and answerability; the clause depicts an enduring disposition in which accountability never enters anticipation.

activation_trace.role: Being or occurrence in time locates the negated expectation as a settled past condition.
Expectant hope supplies the future-facing horizon whose content is negated.
Counting and reckoning identifies the excluded object as an account rather than a vague bad outcome.

changed_reading.before: They did not expect a reckoning.
changed_reading.after: They lived in a settled pattern of keeping counting and answerability outside their future horizon.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins `يرجون`, a projection toward an expected outcome, to `حسابا`, whose branches include mental supposition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two cognitive branches overlap without becoming synonyms: hope projects an outcome, while حسب estimates that something is the case. Negation therefore permits a second-order failure to reckon that reckoning itself is plausible.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope contributes prospective projection toward a possible outcome.
Reckoning as supposition contributes the mental estimate that an account could be real.

changed_reading.after: They did not even entertain, as a live mental estimate, that they would be reckoned with.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun `حسابا` can activate accountable supervision, while `يرجون` marks whether that review is anticipated.
baseline_models.mechanism: If حساب is active oversight and practical holding-to-account rather than only arithmetic, the negated expectation describes conduct organized as though no reviewer will inspect, object, or require correction.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication makes the absence of anticipated oversight a durable mode of conduct.
Expectation supplies the absent anticipation of future review.
Supervision and accountable management recast the account as an active review of conduct.

changed_reading.after: They habitually acted without anticipating accountable oversight or corrective review.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves from reciprocal questioning about a delivered report, through divergent paths, to doubled promised disclosure. This turns the focus from generic disbelief into a failed epistemic forecast: dispute occupies the horizon in which حساب should have been anticipated, until knowledge arrives without their willing projection.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope anchors the model in the focus ayah's prospective stance.
Suppositional reckoning marks the estimate they fail to admit.
Mutual questioning supplies a social field in which the future report is actively discussed.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the contested content that should inform expectation.
Each party taking a different path supplies divergence that displaces a shared estimate of accountability.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the forced epistemic endpoint opposed to present non-expectation.

structural_cues: 78:1-5 opens with question, report, disagreement, and a doubled `they will know` before the focus later diagnoses what they did not expect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, conveyed news, divergent paths, and eventual disclosure; I infer that divergence fills the predictive space from which حساب is excluded. A live alternative is that 78:1-5 frames ignorance generally without specifying the mechanism of 78:27.

changed_reading.before: They lacked belief in a future account.
changed_reading.after: Their non-expectation is an epistemic posture sustained amid contested news, one that eventual disclosure will overturn rather than merely inform.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence repeatedly makes things into functional states, measures creation, joins a structure, presses out provision, and brings hidden growth forth. Against that causal architecture, حساب becomes the moral completion of an already measured world rather than an arbitrary audit added later.

activation_trace.role: Counting, measure, and ordered calculation anchor the focus account in calibrated order.
Expectation asks whether the visible order is projected forward into moral consequence.
Making a thing assume a functional state supplies deliberate arrangement rather than inert inventory.
Measuring and proportioning creation supplies the calibration that resonates with حساب.
Joining parts into a building supplies coherent structure across distinct components.
Pressure that makes something yield supplies a causal conversion from stored potential to output.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the manifest result of the ordered process.

structural_cues: 78:6-16 is a cumulative chain of arrangement, pairing, cycles, construction, rain, and emergence, with repeated first-person making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation and a sequence of functional conversions; I supply the arrow from physical calibration to moral consequence. The live alternative is that the sequence establishes power to recreate without implying that حساب itself is continuous with material order.

changed_reading.before: The reckoning is a later judicial event they did not expect.
changed_reading.after: They fail to project the world's visible calibration and consequence-producing order into an answering moral measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded day separates and judges, is fixed to an appointed limit, and leads to a watchpost already in place. Repeated temporal predication creates an irony between two settled realities: their habitual state of not expecting and the event's already-established timing and readiness.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication anchors their non-expectation as a settled mode.
Expectant hope supplies the temporal horizon that excludes the appointed event.
A delimited duration supplies the temporal container for the reckoning.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the decisive function of that day.
Occurrence in time presents the appointment as established rather than improvised.
Fixing something to a time or limit supplies the event's non-negotiable schedule.
Watchful waiting supplies an already-ready endpoint that meets those who did not anticipate it.

structural_cues: 78:17 names a fixed day of separation, while 78:19-21 repeats `كانت` as sky, mountains, and the watchpost assume their terminal states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed time, separating judgment, repeated temporal predication, and a watchpost; I infer a contrast between the settledness of their disposition and that of the appointment. Alternatively, repeated كان may simply coordinate narrated states without deliberate irony.

changed_reading.before: They habitually did not expect a future audit.
changed_reading.after: Their settled temporal posture excludes an equally settled, timed, and waiting event of separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding `جزاء وفاقا` supplies reciprocal return and a quantity or counterpart fitted to its cause. حساب therefore functions not only as inspection but as the matching operation by which consequence corresponds to action.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning anchors the focus in measured settlement.
Expectation marks whether fitted consequence is admitted into advance reasoning.
Meeting an act with its recompense supplies reciprocal consequence.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart supplies exact fit between deed and result.

structural_cues: 78:26 is a two-word causal verdict immediately before 78:27, so the diagnosis of non-expectation explains the fitted recompense just named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal recompense and equal fit; I infer that حساب names the measuring operation behind that correspondence. A live alternative is that وفاق qualifies the punishment directly without exposing an accounting procedure.

changed_reading.before: They did not expect to be audited.
changed_reading.after: They did not anticipate that their acts would return as precisely fitted consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Active falsification of visible signs follows the focus, but exhaustive enumeration and binding inscription follow that denial. Their missing internal estimate is therefore answered by an external record that neither depends on their expectation nor loses what they reject.

activation_trace.role: Suppositional reckoning anchors the internal estimate absent from the focus.
Attributing falsehood turns passive non-expectation into an active rejection practice.
A manifest sign supplies the evidence that rejection attempts to neutralize.
Comprehensive totality removes any remainder outside the record.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration supplies the external counterpart to حساب.
Binding inscription fixes the enumerated material with normative force.

structural_cues: The coordinated sequence 78:27-29 moves from no expectation, to emphatic denial, to `every thing` exhaustively recorded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial of signs followed by total enumeration and inscription; I infer an inner-erasure versus outer-preservation reversal. The alternative is a cumulative list of offenses and divine knowledge rather than a deliberate answer to their cognitive posture.

changed_reading.before: Their lack of expectation is a private mistaken belief.
changed_reading.after: They actively erase accountability from their own estimate, while an exhaustive external record preserves precisely what their estimate excludes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to taste converts abstract reckoning into tested experience, while increase makes the consequence iterative rather than static. حساب can thus be read as an enacted feedback process whose measured result is undergone and augmented.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning supplies the measured relation that the later experience enacts.
Testing and undergoing a thing turns an abstract result into first-person experience.
Increase and growth supply an accumulating trajectory rather than a closed one-time verdict.
Painful punishment supplies the concrete content that is tasted and increased.

structural_cues: 78:30 directly addresses the group after the account-record sequence and combines imperative experience with exclusive increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies experience, increase, and punishment; I infer that these realize حساب as feedback over time. The live alternative is that 78:30 is rhetorical intensification after a completed account, not part of its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Reckoning is a single completed ledger operation.
changed_reading.after: Reckoning issues into a consequence that becomes experientially known and continues to increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrasting path moves from self-protection to deliverance, then names recompense, giving, and the same surface `حسابا` with a sufficiency branch. The focus account is no longer punishment-only: measure differentiates fitted adverse return from ample gift, and expectation should orient conduct within that bilateral economy.

activation_trace.role: Expectation anchors whether future differentiation affects present orientation.
Counting and account supply the focus's measured outcome frame.
Putting oneself under protection supplies an anticipatory posture that contrasts with no expectation.
Attaining good and escape supplies the positive result of anticipatory self-positioning.
Recompense links the favorable outcome to a return corresponding to conduct.
Giving and presentation supply the positive mode in which the outcome is delivered.
Sufficiency and enoughness make the repeated حساب characterize ample gift as well as account.

structural_cues: 78:31-36 forms a favorable counterpart to 78:21-30, and 78:36 repeats the exact surface `حسابا` from the focus inside `عطاء حسابا`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, deliverance, recompense, gift, and the sufficiency branch of the repeated root; I infer one differentiated economy of consequence. Alternatively, 78:36 may activate only quantitative measure, leaving sufficiency as a secondary lexical resonance.

changed_reading.before: They failed to expect a punitive accounting.
changed_reading.after: They failed to expect a differentiating order of consequence in which conduct meets both fitted penalty and sufficient, ample gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final assembly restricts possession of address, intelligible speech, permission, and correct saying. Read through accountable supervision, حساب becomes answerability under another's authority: one cannot control the hearing, speak by default, or substitute any answer for one that lands correctly.

activation_trace.role: Accountable supervision anchors the focus in an institutional relation of review.
Possession and power of disposal supply the denied control over the exchange.
Reciprocal address supplies the hearing-like relation whose ownership is restricted.
Intelligible speech linking speakers supplies the act withheld by default.
Permission supplies the authorization condition for any answer.
Uttered saying supplies the authorized response once speech is allowed.
Correctness settled opposite error supplies the quality constraint on that response.

structural_cues: 78:37-38 narrows speech in stages: no ownership of address, no speaking, then an exception requiring permission and correctness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restricted address, authorized speech, and correctness; I supply the arrow from this scene to حساب as answerability. A live alternative is that speech regulation describes assembly protocol after accounting rather than the account itself.

changed_reading.before: حساب is chiefly a numerical ledger.
changed_reading.after: حساب also names exposure to authorized review, where control of the exchange is lost and only a permitted, correct answer can stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true day is followed by willing, taking, lordship, and return. Expectation is therefore not merely assent to a proposition: a live future horizon becomes a route one deliberately acquires toward return, while `لا يرجون` names failure to let account reorganize direction.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope anchors a future orientation capable of guiding present movement.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the objective status of the anticipated day.
Will directed toward a thing supplies volitional uptake rather than bare awareness.
Taking and acquiring supplies the deliberate adoption of a route.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the relational destination of return.
Returning to a place supplies a directional endpoint for expectation.

structural_cues: 78:39 converts the declaration `that day is true` into a conditional human response: whoever wills takes a return toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth, willing, taking, and return; I infer that genuine expectation is action-guiding orientation. The alternative is that 78:39 offers a route independently of why the group in 78:27 failed to expect account.

changed_reading.before: Their defect is failure to predict an event.
changed_reading.after: Their defect is a non-projective stance that never becomes deliberate movement toward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning is designed to awaken caution, temporal nearness collapses postponement, and the person finally looks at what the hands sent ahead. The account is thus a confrontation with a self-produced prior deposit, not an alien charge invented at the endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Expectation anchors the missing anticipatory response to warning.
Reckoning anchors the eventual review of what was accumulated.
Warning that arouses caution supplies an explicit attempt to create advance expectation.
Temporal nearness supplies pressure against indefinite deferral.
Directed sight or insight supplies the final inspection absent from their earlier horizon.
Advancing something ahead supplies deeds as a prior deposit awaiting encounter.
What the hands earned supplies personal production and ownership of the reviewed material.

structural_cues: The surah closes by calling the punishment near and staging direct sight of what one's own hands advanced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cautioning warning, nearness, inspection, prior advance, and hand-earned action; I infer a deposited-ledger mechanism connecting deed to account. Alternatively, `what his hands sent ahead` may denote deeds broadly without a storage metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The account is an externally imposed future accusation.
changed_reading.after: The near account reveals and measures material each person has already produced and sent forward, despite warnings meant to make that encounter expectable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from focus ر ج و to م ر ج and its confused-disorder branch, not the ordinary sense of `يرجون`. It remains anchored through that explicit mapping and gains a mechanism from the ordered record in 78:29. Downstream prose should label it a split-root exploratory resonance, never a lexical gloss or replacement translation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their relation to account is internally loose and disordered even as every item is externally ordered and fixed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the `old I-used-to man` branch is an idiomatic lexical byway, not the grammatical value of either `كانوا` or `كنت`. It remains anchored through the repeated focus root and the closing first-person wish, which creates a real temporal reversal. Downstream prose should use it as a qualified echo from habitual third-person past to terminal self-description, not as an etymological translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus `كانوا` establishes their former habitual posture; the same root's B005 idiom foregrounds retrospection and is repeated as `كنت` in 78:40.

activation_trace.role: The idiom of the retrospective `I used to` man foregrounds looking back on a former state.
Spoken utterance turns the earlier third-person diagnosis into a first-person final admission.
The repeated `I was` form closes the temporal arc opened by focus `they used to be`.
Dust and earth supply the wished-for counter-state named in the closing retrospective.

changed_reading.before: `كانوا` only marks a past habitual failure to expect account.
changed_reading.after: The closing `كنت ترابا` reverses that habit into first-person retrospection: the one who would not project an account can finally only wish for a different former state.

strongest_changes: `جزاء وفاقا` makes حساب the operation of fitted consequence, not merely inspection.
Denial in 78:28 is answered by exhaustive enumeration and binding record in 78:29, so accountability persists independently of their estimate.
The repeated `حسابا` in 78:36 activates sufficiency and gift, widening the focus from punishment-only accounting to a bilateral measure of outcomes.
The fixed appointment and the final sight of what the hands advanced turn non-expectation into a durable temporal and practical failure.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made four domains converge on the short focus clause without collapsing them: calibrated material order, exact recompense, external record, and authorized speech. The later exact reuse of حساب also preserved a positive sufficiency branch, while split-root and idiomatic branches yielded contained but genuinely changed exploratory readings.
remaining_uncertainties: At 78:36, sufficiency may be a live lexical activation or only a resonance beside quantitative measure.
The contrast between repeated temporal predications and focus `كانوا` is strong structurally, but deliberate irony cannot be established from the packet alone.
The م ر ج split-root disorder, near-delivery رجاء, and retrospective B005 readings are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
